title: AWS for Engineers
blurb: Amazon Web Services from zero: accounts and billing, EC2, S3, VPC networking, databases, IAM and security, monitoring, DNS and content delivery, load balancing, auto scaling, queues, serverless, containers, infrastructure as code, the Well-Architected pillars, AWS for ML and data, a worked project from one server to a multi-AZ production design, and Solutions Architect exam practice.
sources: AWS Certified Solutions Architect Official Study Guide: Associate Exam (Sybex), ch. 1-14

AWS documentation (docs.aws.amazon.com): EC2, EBS, S3, VPC, RDS, DynamoDB, IAM, Lambda, CloudWatch, Route 53, CloudFront, Elastic Load Balancing, Auto Scaling, SQS, SNS, Kinesis, CloudFormation user guides
AWS Billing user guide: Free Tier (docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling)
Amazon Lightsail, Amazon SageMaker AI and Amazon Bedrock user guides (docs.aws.amazon.com)
AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (SAA-C03) exam guide (docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-certification)
